samples: A heavy smoker with a very high hematocrit and a palpable spleen.
Secondary polycythemia from smoking versus a marrow disorder.
The patient likely has polycythemia vera; itching after a hot shower would support it.
A myeloproliferative picture: high red cells, white cells and platelets.
A small child with ascending weakness after a cold.
Guillain-Barre syndrome or a tick-borne illness.
Lyme disease from the attached tick; an antibiotic answer follows.
